archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) with Terminal/Aceternity elements for a futuristic AI feel

brand.name: CareerAI
brand.tone: Intelligent, precise, empowering, futuristic but professional
brand.core_concept: A deep-tech command center for your career trajectory

headings.usage: Use 'tracking-tight' for all headings. Never center by default. Use fluid scaling.

body.usage: Use loose line height 'leading-relaxed' for readability.

mono.usage: For data metrics, scores, confidence percentages, and AI explanations to add a technical feel.

surfaces_and_textures.header: Crystal Glass: bg-[#05050A]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10 shadow-sm
surfaces_and_textures.cards: Solid dark surface bg-[#111116] border border-white/5 hover:border-white/10 transition-colors duration-300
surfaces_and_textures.ai_elements: Tracing Beam effect: subtle gradient borders that appear active. Add drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(249,115,22,0.3)] on AI insights.
surfaces_and_textures.background_effect: Subtle radial gradients in the background (deep blue/orange) to kill digital flatness without overwhelming the UI.

layout_and_spacing.marketing_pages: Mode A: The Tetris Grid. Asymmetrical Bento grids. Use generous padding p-12 to p-24.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard: Mode B: The Control Room Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. gap-6. Strict hierarchy, every pixel utilized.
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: Cards must use p-6 or p-8 internally to prevent text collision.

components_strategy.buttons: Primary CTA: bg-[#F97316] text-white font-semibold hover:bg-[#FB923C]. Secondary: border border-white/20 bg-transparent text-white hover:bg-white/5. All buttons MUST have data-testid.
components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Inputs should have bg-black/50 border-white/10 focus:border-[#F97316] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#F97316].
components_strategy.charts: Recharts. Use RadarChart for Skill Gap. LineChart for user history. Stroke colors must match brand primary (#F97316) and secondary (#007AFF).
components_strategy.sliders: Interactive sliders for logical/creativity inputs. Thumb: #F97316, Track: #007AFF.
components_strategy.navigation: Sticky top nav with Glassmorphism. Sidebar for Dashboard using 'Grid Borders' (border-r border-white/10) layout.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle lift (-translate-y-1) for cards. Text colors explicitly defined on hover.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer motion fade and slight slide-up (y: 20 -> 0).
motion_and_interactions.ai_loading: Use an ASCII loader or glowing SVG pulse instead of standard spinners.

icons.style: Duotone weight for high-end tech feel.

hero_background.description: Abstract neon lines forming a digital landscape. Apply a strong black overlay (bg-black/60) to ensure text readability.

dashboard_empty_state.description: Wavy abstract lines. Use at very low opacity (10-15%) as a background texture for empty dashboard states.

student_learning.description: A young man studying intensely at night. Use on the marketing page to ground the tech in human reality.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text against dark surfaces meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case representing the role (e.g., data-testid='submit-assessment-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS exclusively for styling.
Implement the UI using React, Shadcn UI, and Recharts.
Run `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react` for the icon library.
Strictly follow the color palette provided. Do not use default Vercel or Tailwind blue.
Ensure the Assessment form uses a step-by-step wizard UI rather than a massive single-page form to reduce cognitive load.
Use Recharts RadarChart to visualize the Skill Gap Analysis.
For the AI Explanation section, implement a typewriter effect or a soft glow border to signify 'AI thinking'.
Admin Panel should be dense and functional, using the 'Control Room' grid (Mode B).
Include a prominent PDF export button on the Recommendations dashboard.
Apply backdrop-blur to sticky headers and modal overlays.
Ensure all Grid children are direct descendants, or use subgrid if nesting is unavoidable.
Do NOT use Space Grotesk font.
Do NOT use Teal (#1B93A4) or Purple (#7351B7).
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms for testing.
